children: Bitcoin's short-term price moves would likely depend on the Fed's interest rate path, after the cryptocurrency topped $80,000 on Thursday, says Mariia Menahem, chief executive of Clarity Global, in a note. Markets are pricing in lower rate hike expectations, as hiring by U.S. private-sector employers saw softer growth in August, she says. Lower rates reduce the appeal of cash and fixed-income assets, weaken the dollar and improve liquidity conditions for risk assets such as bitcoin. Bitcoin is 0.75% lower at $80,874.56, according to LSEG data.(amanda.lee@wsj.com)
